Normalization: Native signed HTTPS observations, no retries. Response bodies and SHA256 are retained in compressed source. XXHASH digest candidates use system libxxhash seed zero, canonical big-endian bytes; accepted checksums and returned headers establish AWS byte order. SDK replay covers expressible modeled requests; raw preserves absent algorithm and explicit empty/malformed wire boundaries. ETags are issued bindings, not plaintext MD5 assumptions. SSE-C uses trusted TLS; SSE-KMS uses existing AWS-managed S3 key. Volatile request IDs, dates, opaque encryption ETags and KMS key ARN are excluded from projections. Cleanup is evidence-only. SDK BadDigest calls replay native supplied mismatches without recalculation; native-observed ETag equality binds later reads to the issued write/copy identity. Attribute/copy projections also assert other checksum families absent.
